landing.top_bar: The student loan designed to finance your studies, with no personal guarantor.
landing.objectif_modal_title: What type of student loan would you like?
landing.taeg_desc: Fixed Annual Percentage Rate, excluding optional insurance. Non-contractual example.
landing.pillar_travaux_desc: Fund your tuition and enrollment fees without waiting on family support.
landing.pillar_auto_desc: Deposit, first rent, move-in costs: a helping hand to get settled.
landing.pillar_tresorerie_desc: Computer, supplies or equipment needed for your studies.
landing.pillar_vacances_desc: Fund your driving licence to gain independence during your studies.
landing.how_title: A financing solution built around student life.
landing.step1_text: A product designed for the expenses tied to your studies.
landing.step2_text: No personal guarantor is required under the offer, subject to the applicable conditions.
landing.step3_text: Amount, duration, rate, total cost and repayment must be understandable before any decision.
landing.step4_text: An initial reply within 24 business hours of your request, so you can move forward without waiting.
landing.how_bottom_title: A loan remains a financial commitment.
landing.how_bottom_text: Before committing, check the borrowed amount, the rate, the total cost, the duration, the monthly payments and the repayment terms. Only borrow what your situation allows you to repay.
landing.review_0_text: "Thanks to them, I could pay my tuition fees without waiting on my parents. Application processed in a week, lovely advisor."
landing.review_1_text: "A student with no guarantor, I thought nobody would approve my file. StudCredit said yes within days, no hassle."
landing.review_2_text: "I funded my year abroad without my parents having to guarantee anything. Simple, fast, transparent from start to finish."
landing.review_3_text: "The simulator gave me a clear idea right away. The advisor did the rest, almost effortlessly on my part."
landing.review_4_text: "Rejected by my usual student bank, accepted in 3 weeks with them, at a much better rate. Thanks."
landing.review_5_text: "The client portal is super well done. You know exactly where your file is, no need to follow up with the advisor every morning."
